decisions.reason: The $15 advertised-price commitment does not change the existing per-sale allocations or fiat-fee treatment.
An optional tip can coexist with the $15 base mint-price commitment and none of the tipping options or placement changes.
The price commitment does not alter the NFT ebook product type or unlimited-mint supply model.
The advertised price does not change wallet provisioning, dashboard access, commission access, prize access, or reward-exit guidance for fiat buyers.
The $15 commitment does not change the deferred Transak integration's provider, payment methods, conversion behavior, or wallet requirements.
The mint-price commitment does not alter the background wallet provisioning trigger, custody model, or setup requirements.
The source does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw condition, ticket rules, or pool-funding sources.
The source does not change the Big Block prize amount, draw trigger, ticket rules, selection method, or pool-funding sources.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records the exact "$15 forever" supporting headline and the $15 CTA, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The About-page statement that the ebook costs $15 remains consistent with the price commitment; the source specifically supplies new hero copy and does not require adding "forever" to the About page.
The $15 mint-price commitment does not change the $5 referral commission amount, qualification rule, delivery, limit, or expiration.
The advertised mint price does not change automatic prize transfer, the payment destination, or winner-announcement channels.
